title: FeeSettings
key_points: The FeeSettings object represents the fee settings for a given account.
It contains the following fields: 'feeN', 'reserveBaseN', and 'reserveIncrementN'.

These fields determine the minimum balance required before sending a transaction, the base reserve amount added to each outgoing payment, and the reserve increment added to each outgoing payment above the reserveBase.
The values of these fields are set when an account is created and can be modified by the account holder using the AccountSet rippled function.
limitations: Assumes prior knowledge of Ripple protocol and concepts
asserts: The FeeSettings object specifies the fee-related parameters for a given Ripple account, including the minimum balance required before sending transactions, base reserve amount added to outgoing payments, and incremental reserve for payments above the reserveBase.
scope: Explains the structure and purpose of the FeeSettings object in the context of the Ripple protocol
